grader.scenario: Suspected UDP DDoS attack flooding residential connection; resolved via remote PPPoE session flush and IP renewal
grader.notes: Okay call where agent blamed customer for gaming traffic initially, saved by PPPoE flush, with handled empathy in the middle third and repeat in the final third.
